title: finding(core/plugin-list): after #8127 declares `page`, `ListView` still cannot draw it — `normalizeListViewSchema` maps `page` to `grid`, so a spec-valid `type: 'page'` view is declared everywhere and drawable nowhere
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (session `session_01QtGhnU3WnnWyiWeYQhw2aX`) as a **landing precondition** of PR #8372, raised by the contract review of that PR (verdict recorded on **#8127**). Unassigned, bare, for triage — grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

⛔ **Not claimed, not dispatched.**

## Why this card has to exist before #8372 lands

PR #8372 carries `Fixes #8127`, so merging it **closes the only card that records this**. The declaration half is genuinely fixed by that PR; the renderer half is not, and it would otherwise disappear from the backlog at the moment of landing.

⚠️ **Not a duplicate of #8127.** That card is the **declaration** gap — `ViewType` in `packages/types/src/views.ts` never gained `page`, so total maps over it compiled green while incomplete. PR #8372 closes exactly that: `ViewType` is now derived from `@objectstack/spec` and carries all 12 arms on both faces. **This card is the renderer gap that the declaration fix makes visible rather than removes.**

## The reading

⚠️ **Provenance stated rather than implied**: the measurements below are the **contract reviewer's**, taken at PR #8372's head `d1f79cdd6cce7e8370949b3733fcce4e6b374522`. This seat has **not** re-driven them; ⛔ re-derive before acting.

- `@object-ui/core` `normalizeListViewSchema`: a `page` kind still resolves to **`grid`**. After #8372 it additionally emits **one `console.warn` per undrawable kind per process** — so the silence becomes a warning, ⛔ not a rendered page.
- The private `UNDRAWABLE_VIEW_KINDS` const is total over **`{ list, detail, page }`**.
- ⇒ A document that `@objectstack/spec` accepts, and that both published `@object-ui/types` faces now accept, renders as **something else entirely**. The PR's own body calls this "the sharpest statement of the bug".

⭐ The class is `declared ≠ enforced`, in the direction this repo has been closing card by card: the contract says yes and the runtime quietly substitutes.

## What this card is NOT asking for

⛔ It does not propose that `ListView` grow a page renderer, and it does not propose narrowing `ViewType` back. Both are dispositions, and picking one is a ruling this card deliberately leaves open. The honest statement of the residual is the deliverable of filing it.

⚠️ Also out of scope, recorded so a taker does not fold it in: the reviewer separately observed the **`defaultViewType` 7-arm family** (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, its zod twin, and `plugin-view`'s registration) is missing `chart` / `tree` — a **different** key on a **different** surface, and worth its own card rather than a rider here.

## Dedup

⚠️ **Bounded and declared.** One `search_issues` over open issues in this repo for the concept (`ListView` / `page` view type / undrawable / renders as grid) returned exactly **1** result — **#8127 itself**, i.e. the card this one is being split from. ⛔ Not an exhaustive sweep. The reviewer independently reported finding no follow-up card. If a taker meets a prior card on this residual, treat it as a duplicate and say so.

Refs: **#8127** (the declaration gap; PR **#8372** closes it) · PR #8372's contract review verdict, recorded on #8127.
